note: Hashes only: no game data, keys or file contents. Read by 'snap_builder.py ... --install-check' and by the launcher's Check install button (copied into launcher_data.json at build time). Build IDs, the 2.0.1 romfs check files and the romfs file-list hash live in versions.json and are not repeated here.
image_hash: SHA-256 over the decompressed text, rodata and data segments of the NSO, in order (the same as versions.json 'nso'); the same value for the compressed and the uncompressed dump of a file.
verified: program_images were computed from one set of dumps made by the project owner from their own game copy (all five versions); the 2.0.1 main and sdk values equal versions.json. No second dump source has confirmed the 1.0.0, 1.1.0 and 1.2.0 values yet.

runtime_files.note: Files that ship with the build and are the same on every PC: any listed hash is accepted for that name. The exe and the converted game images differ per PC; they are checked against install_record.json, which the builder writes next to the exe.
